onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/category.schema.json, set anc_speed_blend to {{anc_speed_blend}}]
Set animation speed blending to {{anc_speed_blend}} mode in the animator graph.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/category.schema.json, set anc_dir_anim to {{anc_dir_anim}}]
Set movement direction animation (MovementDirectionYaw variable tracking) to {{anc_dir_anim}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/animation/category.schema.json, set ant_grounded_threshold to {{ant_grounded_threshold}}]
Set AnimationController.groundedThreshold to {{ant_grounded_threshold}}. Controls the IsRecentlyGrounded detection range.
